fields.label: Description
fields.description: What this knowledge base contains. Helps the agent decide when to query it.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: When unchecked, the KB is hidden from list_knowledge_bases / search_kb.

fields.label: Public (visible to all users)
fields.description: When checked, every authenticated user can query this KB. Otherwise only the owner. System Manager only.

fields.options:
A Knowledge Base is a collection of attached files the agent can search via the search_kb tool. Save this doc, then use the Attach button (sidebar) to upload files in any of these formats:

  • Text — .txt, .md, .csv, .json, .yaml, .py
  • PDF — .pdf (pdfplumber / pypdf required)
  • Excel — .xlsx (openpyxl)
  • Word — .docx (python-docx)

The agent answers from these files using keyword search by default. Embeddings / vector search are deferred to a future slice.

Example queries
  • "What's the return-policy notice period?" — agent calls search_kb(query="return policy notice period") and pulls the relevant clause.
  • "Which SKUs are 'Premium' tier?" — searches the product catalog spreadsheet.
